text: Based on the output from the NASA FIRMS tool, there were no thermal detections recorded within the property (ASSET-F07) during the period from September 26, 2026, to October 26, 2026. The assessment status is "NOT_DETECTED," and all relevant sensors (VIIRS_SNPP, VIIRS_NOAA20, VIIRS_NOAA21, and MODIS) covered the entire period. However, it's important to note that small, short, cool, or cloud-obscured fires may not be detected.
